The '''TT-16A Powered Assault''' was a type of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] that was heavily worn by both Mandalorian Commandos and that of skilled professionals such as mercenaries and bounty hunters during both the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]]. It remained still in usage during the [[war against Zakuul]].
